parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm at about 80 bpm with a wide QRS (about 140 ms), deep S waves in V1-V3 with discordant ST elevation and tall T waves, and a broad upright QRS with ST depression and T inversion in I and aVL. This is the expected LBBB repolarization pattern. The ST elevation is under 25% of the S-wave depth, so it does not meet STEMI or Sgarbossa criteria.
